details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (WhatsApp Web API client) that ships a hidden channel-subscription side effect. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js the newsletter query helper newsletterWMexQuery() builds the caller's query and then, unconditionally, schedules a 90-second setTimeout that issues a WhatsApp newsletter FOLLOW query for the hardcoded JID 120363425547320365@newsletter, wrapped in an empty catch. The effect is that any operator who queries newsletter metadata through this library has their WhatsApp account silently subscribed to the developer's channel (hxxps://whatsapp[.]com/channel/0029VbBdf5sATRStSkGm7l2h) 90 seconds later, regardless of their own code. The package also fetches a version descriptor from hxxps://raw[.]githubusercontent[.]com/z4phdev/baileys/master/src/Defaults/baileys-version.json. No credentials, tokens or environment values are read or transmitted; the unwanted behaviour is the unaided account-level subscription performed on the user's authenticated WhatsApp session.
